text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (12.2% vs 3.8%, 2,295 claims, z 1.44, 17% low complexity, 30 documented, 6 documented 99215, 0 below billed, 19 and 2 on data). However, several claims are inaccurate or ungrounded, and the summary is internally inconsistent, so it is not fully reliable.","problems":["Headline says 'roughly double the all-provider rate in every complexity stratum', but the card shows ratios of about 1.95, 1.6, 2.1, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0; the 1-condition stratum (0.053 vs 0.033) is only about 1.6x, so 'every' is overstated.","The 'problems 10%, late 0%, unsigned 0%, data 7%' figures are not on the card (the script could not match 10 and 7); they are only grounded if they appear in tool output, which is not evident.","Claims 'the returned notes also show some repeated time entries' with no support in the card; the only time examples are 45 and 54 minutes.","Says the C0296764 note is 'flagged for a problems signal'; the card does not show per-note flags, so this is ungrounded.","The 9% comparison rate for below-billed documented 99215 is close to the card's all-provider 0.091 but is described as 'comparison providers', a minor mismatch.","Says 'a sicker panel does not explain it' and 'consistent with a provider-level coding habit', which is stronger than the 'inconclusive' leaning and the z of only 1.44 warrant.","Example claims for next steps (C0297696, C0298054, C0298917) are cited in the rationale but not in cited_claim_ids; the 'back pain and abdominal pain' remark is fine, but C0298917 is Z09, not either.","Rationale is padded and repeats points; the next steps are only the generic 'request charts' with two claims."]}
